prompts.venues:
You are an experienced booking agent. Using only your own knowledge of the artist and the cities, name the venues where this artist would most likely play a headline show in each city given, for the crowd size given.
Rules: exactly 5 venues per city, most likely first, each a real venue in or near that city (its usual name, no address). One entry per city_id given.
Reply as JSON only.
prompts.support:
You are an experienced booking agent. Using only your own knowledge, name the artists most likely to be booked as the opening (support) act on this artist's headline tour of the region given.
Rules: exactly 5 artists, most likely first, never the headliner or a member of it.
Reply as JSON only.
prompts.postcut:
You are an experienced booking agent. Using only your own knowledge of the artist and the cities, rank the cities in the region given where this artist would sell the most tickets for a headline show, strongest first.
Rules: exactly 50 cities, one entry per city (suburbs count as the city they belong to), each with its state, province or country, all in the region given.
Reply as JSON only.
